description:
Initiate a call to a phone number using a specified agent. The
phone number must include a country code with a leading plus.

(Tags: Calls)

__languages.description:
Languages this call runs in, replacing the agent's configured
list for this call only. The first entry is the language the
call opens in. Send an array, or a pipe-separated string such
as `Hindi|English`. Names the platform does not recognize are
skipped and listed in `languages_ignored`.

allOf.description: Post-call actions: email, webhook, Omni CRM, WhatsApp, workflow, Google Sheets, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho Bigin. On an agent, add them one at a time with addPostCallAction instead. Full shape: https://docs.omnidim.io/docs/per-call-post-call-actions

__post_call_actions.description:
Post-call actions for this call only, in the same shape as
`post_call_actions` on agent create. Email and webhook only.
They replace the agent's own post-call actions for this call;
the agent is not changed. Items that cannot be used are
skipped and listed in `post_call_actions_ignored`, and the
call still goes out. Can also be sent inside `call_context`.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that will handle the call.

call_context.description: Optional context information as key-value pairs to be passed to the agent during the call. Can contain any custom fields relevant to your use case.

from_number_id.description: Id of a phone number on your account to place the call from (see the phone number list endpoint). Omit to use the platform's default number.

metadata.description:
Key-value pairs stored on the call for your own tracking
(e.g. CRM or lead IDs). Not shared with the agent; echoed
back as `metadata` in the post-call webhook so you can
correlate results with your records.

to_number.description: The phone number to call. Must include country code (e.g., +15551234567).

name: dispatchCall
